new_categories.label: cargo_dust_control_service_readiness
new_categories.memory: Cargo-dust control is a delivered hold-service state distinct from final cleanliness, ventilation and generic atmosphere monitoring.

new_categories.label: dust_generation_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: Dust-control assurance can be bounded to a hold, zone or cargo-work scope without retaining exact cargo type, concentration, task or generation rate.

new_categories.label: suppression_support_availability
new_categories.memory: Dust-suppression support availability is separable from dust generation and final dust-condition judgment without retaining medium, flow or equipment settings.

new_categories.label: collection_support_availability
new_categories.memory: Dust-collection support availability is a distinct service dimension from suppression and housekeeping outcome without retaining collection arrangement or equipment parameters.

new_categories.label: dust_migration_boundary_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence that dust-control scope remains bounded can be represented separately from generation, suppression and collection without exact compartment or transfer-path details.

new_categories.label: non_numeric_dust_condition_monitoring_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-numeric confidence in dust condition or control effectiveness can be retained without concentrations, exposure limits, alarm thresholds or measurement rules.

new_categories.label: dust_control_function_effectiveness_confidence
new_categories.memory: Control-function effectiveness can be represented independently of support availability and final housekeeping condition without operational settings or procedures.

new_categories.label: support_dependency_confidence
new_categories.memory: Delivered dust-control assurance depends on bounded utilities, distribution, collection or monitoring support that can degrade separately from the control function itself.

new_categories.label: cleanliness_and_housekeeping_not_service_equivalence
new_categories.memory: A clean-looking hold or downstream housekeeping confidence is not equivalent to dust-control, suppression or collection service readiness.

new_categories.label: dust_control_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: Dust-control service can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-restoration and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_restriction_and_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction or isolation can attach separately to dust-control function, suppression support, collection support, monitoring, boundary scope or a bounded cargo-work zone.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Cargo-work restriction, housekeeping concern, equipment unavailability, terminal concern, rework or schedule effects do not prove a dust-control, suppression, collection or scope root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_dust_control_restoration
new_categories.memory: Control-path recovery, suppression/collection support restoration, monitoring verification, restriction release and return to normal cargo-work assurance can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: washdown_cleaning_vs_dust_control
useful_refinements.memory: P117 cleaning/washdown service can remove residue but does not establish dust-generation control, suppression or collection readiness during cargo work.

useful_refinements.label: environment_monitoring_vs_dust_control
useful_refinements.memory: P110 hold temperature/humidity monitoring does not establish dust-control function or suppression/collection support.

useful_refinements.label: fire_suppression_vs_dust_suppression
useful_refinements.memory: P106 fixed fire-suppression assurance is a different protective function from non-procedural cargo-dust suppression/control service-state.

useful_refinements.label: ventilation_vs_dust_control_support
useful_refinements.memory: P089 hold ventilation/air exchange may interact with airborne dust but is not equivalent to the delivered dust-control, suppression or collection service.

duplicates.label: generic_delivered_service_support_monitoring_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic delivered-service, support dependency and monitoring-confidence mechanics repeat prior shipboard assurance families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_downstream_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic restriction/isolation, downstream-effect separation and multi-stage verified restoration are already campaign-wide.
